Container.Name: signal-web
Container.Overview:
WhatsApp-Web-style browser client for Signal. Links to your phone as a Signal device (like Signal Desktop) through the signal-api container, stores your chat history locally, and serves a password-protected web UI.
Requires the signal-api container (bbernhard/signal-cli-rest-api) on the same custom Docker network ("signal"), running with MODE=json-rpc-native. See the project README for setup.
Container.Requires: The signal-api container (template unraid/signal-api.xml in the project repo) on the custom Docker network "signal".

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Password for the web interface. At least 8 characters; use a long one.

Config.Name: Signal API URL
Config.Description: Address of the signal-api container. The default works when both containers are on the 'signal' network.

Config.Name: Giphy API key
Config.Description: Enables the GIF picker. Create a free key at developers.giphy.com (Create an App, choose API).

Config.Name: Giphy rating
Config.Description: Content rating for GIF search results.

Config.Name: Send read receipts
Config.Description: Tell senders when you've read their messages in Signal Web.

Config.Name: Secure cookies (HTTPS)
Config.Description: Set to true when you reach Signal Web over HTTPS (e.g. via a reverse proxy).

Config.Name: Signal number
Config.Description: Only needed if the signal-api container holds more than one account.

Config.Name: Session length (days)
Config.Description: How long a browser stays signed in.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the files in /data.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the files in /data.
